text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Kadar Caruman Bagi

Pemandu Teksi) 2017.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah mula berkuat kuasa pada 13 Jun 2017.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, "pemandu teksi" ertinya mana-mana orang

bekerja sendiri yang—

(a) menjalankan aktiviti pekerjaan sendiri sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam

butiran 1 Jadual Pertama kepada Akta;

(b) mempunyai lesen memandu yang sah yang dikeluarkan di bawah seksyen 26

Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987 [Akta 333]; dan

(c) bagi maksud perenggan (a), telah dikeluarkan baginya—

(i) suatu lesen pengendali yang sah di bawah seksyen 18

Akta Pengangkutan Awam Darat 2010 [Akta 715] dan suatu kad

pemandu yang sah oleh Suruhanjaya Pengangkutan Awam Darat; atau

(ii) suatu lesen yang sah oleh Lembaga Pelesenan Kenderaan Perdagangan

di bawah seksyen 16 Akta Lembaga Pelesenan Kenderaan

Perdagangan 1987 [Akta 334].

Kadar caruman

3. (1) Tiap-tiap pemandu teksi hendaklah membayar suatu caruman kepada

Pertubuhan atau ejen keselamatan sosial pekerjaan sendiri pada kadar sebagaimana

yang dipilih oleh pemandu teksi itu berdasarkan Pendapatan Bulanan Pilihan yang

Diinsuranskan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

(2) Tempoh pelindungan bagi kadar caruman yang dipilih oleh seorang

pemandu teksi di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah selama tempoh dua belas bulan

berturut-turut.

(3) Jika dalam tempoh pelindungan yang disebut dalam subperaturan (2)

kesahan lesen pengendali dan kad pemandu yang dikeluarkan oleh Suruhanjaya

Pengangkutan Awam Darat atau lesen yang dikeluarkan oleh Lembaga Pelesenan

Kenderaan Perdagangan habis tempoh—

(a) tempoh pelindungan itu hendaklah terus berkuat kuasa sehingga

tempoh dua belas bulan berturut-turut itu habis; dan

(b) seorang pemandu teksi hendaklah mengemukakan kepada Pertubuhan,

apabila diminta oleh Pertubuhan, lesen pengendali, kad pemandu atau

lesen baharunya untuk penentusahan.

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY

(RATES OF CONTRIBUTION FOR TAXI DRIVER) REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 10 and paragraph 83(2)(h) of the

Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes the following

regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Rates of Contribution For Taxi Driver) Regulations 2017.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 13 June 2017.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations, "taxi driver" means any self-employed person who—

(a) carries out the self-employment activity as specified in item 1 of

the First Schedule to the Act;

(b) holds a valid driving licence issued under section 26 of

the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]; and

(c) for the purposes of paragraph (a), has been issued with—

(i) a valid operator's licence under section 18 of

the Land Public Transport Act 2010 [Act 715] and a valid driver's card

by the Suruhanjaya Pengangkutan Awam Darat; or

(ii) a valid licence by the Commercial Vehicles Licensing Board under

section 16 of the Commercial Vehicles Licensing Board Act 1987

[Act 334].

Rates of contribution

3. (1) Every taxi driver shall pay a contribution to the Organization or any

self-employment social security agent at the rates as selected by the taxi driver based on

the Selected Insured Monthly Earning as specified in the Schedule.

(2) The coverage period for the rates of contribution selected by a taxi driver

under subregulation (1) shall be for a period of twelve consecutive months.

(3) If within the coverage period referred to in subregulaton (2) the validity of

an operator's licence and a driver's card issued by the Suruhanjaya Pengangkutan

Awam Darat or a licence issued by the Commercial Vehicles Licensing Board expires—

(a) the coverage period shall continue to have effect until the period of

twelve consecutive months expires; and

(b) a taxi driver shall submit to the Organization, upon request by the

Organization, his new operator's licence, driver's card or licence for

verification.
